mentions.name: Asteria 4X
mentions.description: A 4X space strategy game inspired by the 1995 classic Stars!, cloning its core gameplay while adding original touches and lots of high sci-fi concepts; already fun to play, with early access coming soon on Steam.
mentions.source_excerpt: I cloned the core and I'm also adding my own touch and lots of high sci-fi concepts. Already fun to play, early access coming soon: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5482440/Asteria_4X
